name: chicken veloute
instructions:
Velouté sauce / chicken gravy. THE BASE is the recipe: CHICKEN STOCK + FLOUR + BUTTER + SALT + PEPPER. The variants are things you ADD to the base.

=== THE BASE ===

1. ROUX: melt the butter, whisk in the flour, cook briefly.
2. Whisk in the CHICKEN STOCK gradually until smooth; simmer to gravy thickness.
3. SALT + PEPPER.

=== TESTED COMBO — MUSTARD + POWDERED SAGE ===

Mustard + POWDERED SAGE whisked into the base. A combo I like.

Future combos join as they're tested.
notes:
=== THE FORMAT — BASE + ADD-IN VARIANTS ===

The base (chicken stock, flour, butter, salt, pepper) is the dish; variants are add-in combos on top of it. Tested so far: MUSTARD + POWDERED SAGE.

=== WHERE IT BELONGS — MASH + POACHED BREAST, NOT FRIED THIGH ===

These chicken gravies specifically taste the best with MASHED POTATOES/TURNIP ([[turnip-mashed-potatoes]] — where this gravy is a gratin option) and POACHED CHICKEN BREAST. I don't think it's appropriate for FRIED CHICKEN THIGH.
